articles.summary: DUBLIN and SHANGHAI, Aug. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- PDD Holdings Inc. (“PDD Holdings” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: PDD), today announced its unaudited financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026. articles.summary: DUBLIN and SHANGHAI, Aug. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- PDD Holdings Inc.
